title: PG: Psycho Goreman
review: I know a comedy is good, when I can watch it again and still laugh at the jokes. I enjoyed this quite a lot during my second watch, and my only real criticism is the lack of variety in the locations, and the final showdown scene which goes on for far too long. I would have liked to see more of PG around the house, or at the mall or something, instead of so many epic fights at the end. There's no real jeopardy so it's hard to stay engaged. I feel this way about all superhero battles.
